ana: (typo) sorry, updated below. Added redirect plan and fixed lint in draft. Draft blurb: ```
What's new  Adaptive routing (beta)
- Opt-in per route: adaptive_routing.enabled = true. Prefers cost-efficient variants and automatically falls back to compatible variants.
- Fallback order: hosted -> dedicated -> fallback-variant (configurable). Canary: 10% for 24h, then 50% for 48h.
Known issues:
- On some T4 hosts a transient ~5-12ms increase at seq=512 can occur while the KV cache warms. Mitigation: pin variant or disable adaptive_routing for latency-sensitive routes. Repro: ./tools/bench --seq 512 --target routing-canary (staging).

Quick snippets:
Curl (changelog-friendly):
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rodeo-3","prompt":"Write a haiku","routing":{"adaptive_routing":{"enabled":true}}}'

Python (how-to):
from redwood import Client
with Client() as client:
    resp = client.generate("Summarize this doc", model="rodeo-3", routing={"adaptive_routing": {"enabled": True}})
    print(resp.text)
```
